HELPING AND SUPPORTING FAMILIES AFFECTED BY LEUKODYSTROPHIES

- Human support

- Financial support

For example, since 1994, ELA has invited all its member families to Center Parcs for a weekend each year. This is an opportunity for patientsand their familiesto exchange ideas, share and relax.
